name: Expert_ABC_WS_Stoch
summary: This EA uses a Stochastic oscillator combined with a moving average filter (CBC_WS_Stoch) to generate trading signals within the MQL5 Standard Library Expert Advisor framework. It employs fixed lot sizing for money management and no trailing stop, relying on the signal thresholds to open and close positions based on overbought/oversold mean reversion logic.
summary_zh: 该EA使用随机指标(Stochastic)结合移动平均线过滤器(CBC_WS_Stoch)在MQL5标准库EA框架内生成交易信号。它采用固定手数进行资金管理，不使用追踪止损，依赖信号阈值在超买/超卖均值回归逻辑下开仓和平仓。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是基于Stochastic随机指标与移动平均线的组合信号过滤器CBC_WS_Stoch。入场条件基于Stochastic指标的超买超卖区域判断，结合MA周期为5的短期移动平均线作为辅助过滤，当综合信号强度超过开仓阈值(默认40)时开仓，低于平仓阈值(默认20)时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数模式(MoneyFixedLot)，默认手数为0.1，不随账户余额动态调整。资金管理方面，设置了10%的百分比参数，但实际使用固定手数，风险控制相对简单。没有设置止损(Signal_StopLevel=0)和止盈(Signal_TakeLevel=0)，完全依赖信号反转来平仓，这意味着如果信号不及时反转，可能面临较大亏损。未使用追踪止损(TrailingNone)，出场仅靠信号触发或挂单过期(4根K线)，整体策略偏向均值回归思路。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the CBC_WS_Stoch signal filter, which combines the Stochastic oscillator with a short-period moving average (MA period=5). Entry conditions rely on the Stochastic indicator's overbought/oversold zones, with the MA serving as an auxiliary filter; a trade is opened when the composite signal strength exceeds the open threshold (default 40) and closed when it falls below the close threshold (default 20). Position sizing uses a fixed lot model (MoneyFixedLot) with a default of 0.1 lots, which does not dynamically adjust based on account balance or equity. Money management sets a 10% percent parameter but effectively uses fixed lots, making risk control relatively simplistic. Notably, there is no stop loss (Signal_StopLevel=0) and no take profit (Signal_TakeLevel=0), meaning the EA relies entirely on signal reversal for exits, which can lead to significant losses if signals fail to reverse in time. No trailing stop is used (TrailingNone), and exits are triggered solely by signal changes or pending order expiration (4 bars), reflecting a mean reversion philosophy overall.
pros: 基于MQL5标准库Expert框架开发，代码结构规范清晰，模块化设计易于扩展
Stochastic与MA组合过滤减少了虚假信号，非标准K周期(47)可避免常见参数拥堵
信号阈值机制(开仓40/平仓20)提供了灵活的信号灵敏度控制，可适应不同市场环境
pros_en: Built on the MQL5 Standard Library Expert framework with clean, modular code structure that is easy to extend
Stochastic + MA combination filter reduces false signals; the non-standard K period (47) avoids common parameter congestion
Signal threshold mechanism (open=40/close=20) provides flexible signal sensitivity control adaptable to different market conditions
cons: 没有设置止损和止盈(Signal_StopLevel=0, Signal_TakeLevel=0)，单笔交易风险敞口无限
固定手数资金管理不随账户增长动态调整，无法实现复利效应也不适应不同账户规模
不使用追踪止损且挂单过期仅4根K线，可能在剧烈行情中错过最佳出场时机或频繁挂单失效
cons_en: No stop loss or take profit configured (both set to 0), exposing each trade to unlimited risk
Fixed lot money management does not dynamically adjust with account growth, preventing compounding and not adapting to different account sizes
No trailing stop and pending order expiration of only 4 bars may cause missed exit opportunities in volatile markets or frequent order expirations
improvements: 增加止损和止盈参数设置，至少设置一个合理的默认止损水平以控制单笔最大亏损
将固定手数资金管理替换为动态比例仓位管理(如MoneyFixedMargin或MoneyFixedPercent)，使仓位随账户权益自动调整
improvements_en: Add stop loss and take profit parameter settings with reasonable default values to control maximum per-trade loss
Replace fixed lot money management with dynamic proportional position sizing (e.g., MoneyFixedMargin or MoneyFixedPercent) so lot sizes auto-adjust with account equity

risk_points: 止损和止盈均为0，交易完全依赖信号反转出场，在极端行情下面临巨大亏损风险
没有新K线检查(Expert_EveryTick=false但非基于新Bar逻辑)，可能在同一根K线内重复信号导致异常行为
risk_points_en: Stop loss and take profit are both 0, relying entirely on signal reversal for exits, facing huge loss risk in extreme market conditions
No new bar check mechanism (Expert_EveryTick=false but not based on new bar logic), which may cause repeated signals within the same bar leading to anomalous behavior

It employs fixed lot sizing for money management and no trailing stop, relying on the signal thresholds to open and close positions based on overbought/oversold mean reversion logic.
